widgets.title: Failed Celery Tasks
nrql:
SELECT sum(acme_backend.celery.signals)
FROM Metric
WHERE task_name != 'backend.tasks.run_reconciliation_tests'
  AND clusterName = concat('acme-cluster-', {{env}})
  AND status = 'failure'
FACET task_name
LIMIT 10
SINCE 1800 seconds ago

queries.expr: topk(10, sum by (task_name)(avg_over_time(acme_backend_celery_signals{task_name!="backend.tasks.run_reconciliation_tests",cluster="Func(name='concat', args=[Lit(value='acme-cluster-'), Attr(name='{{env}}')], where=None, cases=[])",status="failure"}[$__range])))

notes: attribute 'task_name' not in label_map; used 'task_name' — verify the label exists in your stack
attribute 'status' not in label_map; used 'status' — verify the label exists in your stack
FACET attribute 'task_name' not in label_map; used 'task_name'
assumed gauge 'acme_backend_celery_signals'; verify metric name/type in Mimir and add to metric_map if wrong
sum() of a gauge: NR sums datapoints; emitted sum of per-series averages (current-total semantics)
timefrom:now-1800s
